description: Look up a Vancouver address, or a resident's surname from 1945 or earlier, in AddressLore's coverage. Returns the matching house's path for house_history, or says plainly that the address isn't covered (never a nearby house in its place), with the covered streets.

query.description: An address ("526 Keefer Street") or a surname ("Clandenning").

name: find_house
title: Find a house
